title: prove-red runs at the root, so a solo-lane RED is pytest exit 4 (test file absent), not a failing assertion
detail: On the trivial/solo lane the new test lives only in worktrees/solo. gate prove-red runs verify_command with cwd=root (gate.py ~2749), so pytest exits 4 (file not found) and the gate records 'RED baseline captured (exit 4 != 0) — verify is load-bearing'. Nothing was proved about the test's assertions. Seen in wrapped-command-naming 2026-11-19. Fix: run prove-red in the lane's worktree when one exists, and treat collection/usage exits (pytest 4/5) as no verdict, not RED.
